description: Land Title Settlement Department - Etthiligoda South, Galle Four Gravets D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810017
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications) in various locations in Galle District. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
